implementation: Canonical Ltd. Ubuntu 22.04 Libgcrypt Cryptographic Module (NEON)
description: libgcrypt library implementation providing cryptographic services to Linux user space software components in general and to GnuPG in particular. The module was tested with 64 bit word size. The following cipher implementation is covered: ARM NEON SHA implementation.
